#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <utility>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Fraction {
    ll a, b;
};

pair<ll, ll> geta(int x, int y, int b) {
    ll lower = (ll)b * x / y;
    ll upper = ((ll)b * x + (y - 1)) / y;
    return {lower, upper};
}

struct LessByError {
    int x, y;
    explicit LessByError(int x_, int y_) : x(x_), y(y_) {}

    bool operator()(const Fraction& p, const Fraction& q) const {
        ll left = std::llabs((ll)x * p.b * q.b - p.a * q.b * y);
        ll right = std::llabs((ll)x * p.b * q.b - q.a * p.b * y);

        if (left != right) return left < right;
        if (p.b != q.b) return p.b < q.b;
        return p.a < q.a;
    }
};

void solve(int x, int y, int n) {
    vector<Fraction> cands;
    cands.reserve(2 * n);

    for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        pair<ll, ll> ap = geta(x, y, b);
        cands.push_back({ap.first, b});
        cands.push_back({ap.second, b});
    }

    vector<Fraction>::iterator it = min_element(cands.begin(), cands.end(), LessByError(x, y));
    cout << it->a << "/" << it->b << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    solve(x, y, n);
    return 0;
}

    return {lower, upper};

static inline bool is_better(ll a1, ll b1, ll a2, ll b2, int x, int y) {
    ll left = std::llabs((ll)x * b1 * b2 - a1 * b2 * y);
    ll right = std::llabs((ll)x * b1 * b2 - a2 * b1 * y);

    if (left != right) return left < right;
    if (b1 != b2) return b1 < b2;
    return a1 < a2;
}

void solve(int x, int y, int n) {
    ll bestA = 0, bestB = 1;
    bool have = false;

    for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        pair<ll, ll> ap = geta(x, y, b);

        if (!have) {
            bestA = ap.first;
            bestB = b;
            have = true;
        } else if (is_better(ap.first, b, bestA, bestB, x, y)) {
            bestA = ap.first;
            bestB = b;
        }

        if (is_better(ap.second, b, bestA, bestB, x, y)) {
            bestA = ap.second;
            bestB = b;
        }
    }

    cout << bestA << "/" << bestB << '\n';
}
